description: Corpus write guard: DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE env var and read_only_context() context manager block all corpus writes at the _write_record/_write_records level.
invariants: DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE=0 / false / no / empty / off does NOT block writes
CorpusWriteBlockedError is raised (not silenced) — callers must handle it
read_only_context() is a context manager wrapping _assert_writes_allowed
read_only_context() restores previous value of DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE on exit
Both _write_record and _write_records call _assert_writes_allowed before any I/O
